script.name: t_h1_gateway_bad_input
script.objective: [H1] Start gateway-rs (port read with tapi_netexpose). On separate connections send an empty body, an oversized body (4 MiB) and a malformed header; after each, a valid request on a new connection. FAIL (H1:proven) if the gateway exits (non-zero exit code or signal) or the port closes; PASS (H1:disproved) if every valid request is answered. Exit code and statuses are recorded.

script.name: t_h2_go_slow_client
script.objective: [H2] Start service-go (port read with tapi_netexpose), open ten connections that send nothing and send one normal request at the same time. FAIL (H2:proven) if the normal request takes more than 5 s or an idle connection is still open after 30 s.

script.name: t_h3_cs_swallowed_error
script.objective: [H3] Start service-cs (port read with tapi_netexpose) and send an invalid payload (non-numeric value and hops). PASS (H3:disproved) only on a 4xx or 5xx status; FAIL (H3:proven) on 200. Status and body are recorded.

script.name: t_h4_binscan_netexpose_egress
script.objective: [H4] Run the three services (ports read with tapi_netexpose), send one normal request to each and compare all their outgoing connections (tapi_egress) with an allowed list of loopback only; each unexpected destination goes into the tapi_cybersec_report. Also fail if tapi_netexpose shows a service listening on a non-loopback address. FAIL (H4:proven) on any finding. tapi_binscan on gateway-rs, service-go and service-cs adds its result to the report as context only and never fails the test. A scanner that returns no data at all gives INCONCLUSIVE, naming the scanner.

script.name: t_h5_go_contract_limits
script.objective: [H5] Start service-go (port read with tapi_netexpose) and send messages at the contract limits: empty, maximum length (64 characters), maximum plus one, wrong type. FAIL (H5:proven) if any invalid message gets a 2xx reply; every status is recorded.

script.name: s_rust
script.objective: [smoke] Start gateway-rs and send one valid request. Checks that the process is still running (no exit code) and that the response is 2xx with a body carrying "value=". Settles no hypothesis.

script.name: s_c
